lines.text: Four half circles make a flower inside a square.
lines.caption: Four half circles make a flower inside a square.

lines.text: Most kids find the white petals. But we want the SHADED part!
lines.caption: Most kids find the white petals. But we want the SHADED part!

lines.text: The square has side four, and each side holds a half circle.
lines.caption: The square has side four, and each side holds a half circle.

lines.text: What is the total shaded area?
lines.caption: What is the total shaded area?

lines.text: Trick: each half circle has area two pi, so all four make eight pi.
lines.caption: Trick: each half circle has area two pi, so all four make eight pi.

lines.text: But the square is only sixteen! Every petal got counted twice.
lines.caption: But the square is only sixteen! Every petal got counted twice.

lines.text: So eight pi is the square, plus the petals one extra time.
lines.caption: So eight pi is the square, plus the petals one extra time.

lines.text: Petals are eight pi minus sixteen. Take them away from the square.
lines.caption: Petals are eight pi minus sixteen. Take them away from the square.

lines.text: Shaded is thirty-two minus eight pi! That's Choice B.
lines.caption: Shaded is thirty-two minus eight pi! That's Choice B.

lines.text: Why exactly that? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
